grammarFocus: 一般过去时；规则与常用不规则过去式；then / after that / finally。
title: A Weekend Trip to Hangzhou
instructions: 这是为A2水平学习者编写的原创模拟阅读材料，主题为旅行经历与基础测评。请先通读短文，再完成10道题。单选题从选项中选出正确答案；填空题的答案必须来自原文，且不超过规定的词数；判断题有三个选项：正确、错误、未提及。所有解释均为中文，证据为原文原句。
passage:
Last month, Li Ming had a short holiday. He wanted to visit his sister in Hangzhou. On Friday evening, he packed a small bag. He put in two T-shirts, a jacket, and his phone charger. Then he went to bed early.

On Saturday morning, Li Ming got up at six o'clock. He took a bus to the train station. The bus was slow, so he arrived late. He ran to the gate, but the train left at seven fifteen. He missed it! He felt sad. After that, he bought a new ticket for nine o'clock. He waited in a small café and drank a cup of tea.

The train trip took two hours. Li Ming arrived in Hangzhou at eleven o'clock. His sister, Li Hua, met him at the station. She smiled and said, "Welcome!" They ate lunch in a noodle shop near West Lake. The noodles were hot and very good. Li Ming paid thirty yuan for two bowls.

In the afternoon, they walked around West Lake. The weather was sunny and warm. They took many photos. Li Ming bought a small paper fan for his mother. It cost twenty yuan. Finally, they went to Li Hua's flat. They cooked dinner together and talked about their family. Li Ming went to bed at ten o'clock. He was tired but very happy.

grammar.title: 一般过去时：规则与常用不规则过去式；then / after that / finally
grammar.explanation: 一般过去时表示过去发生的动作。规则动词一般加 -ed，例如 pack → packed，arrive → arrived。不规则动词要单独记，例如 get → got，take → took，buy → bought，pay → paid，go → went。表示顺序时，可以用 then（然后）、after that（在那之后）、finally（最后）来连接句子。
grammar.example: Then he went to bed early. After that, he bought a new ticket for nine o'clock. Finally, they went to Li Hua's flat.

questions.prompt: 选择正确的过去式：Yesterday I ___ to the park.
questions.explanation: go 的不规则过去式是 went。
questions.evidence: Then he went to bed early.

questions.prompt: 选择正确的过去式：She ___ a new bag last week.
questions.explanation: buy 的不规则过去式是 bought。
questions.evidence: He bought a new ticket for nine o'clock.

questions.prompt: 选择正确的过去式：We ___ at the station at nine.
questions.explanation: arrive 是规则动词，过去式加 -d，变成 arrived。
questions.evidence: Li Ming arrived in Hangzhou at eleven o'clock.

questions.prompt: 选择正确的顺序词：We ate lunch. ___, we walked around the lake.
questions.explanation: after that 表示“在那之后”，用于连接先后发生的动作。
questions.evidence: After that, he bought a new ticket for nine o'clock.
